notes.title: The Blind Prophet is now available in Russian
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33967282/616e946ff7590cb9d27800dd7836546cd97711b8.jpg[/img]

[b]С большой радостью сообщаю, что The Blind Prophet была переведена на русский язык замечательной командой переводчиков-любителей Prometheus Project. Игру можно приобрести в Steam![/b]

[b]Если у вас возникнут проблемы, пожалуйста, свяжитесь с нами через обсуждения или по электронной почте arsgoetiagames@gmail.com[/b]

English: I'm very glad to announce that The Blind Prophet has been translated in russian by a great fan community called Prometheus Project. You can now get it from Steam!


See you soon, sinners! 

Ars Goetia

notes.title: The Blind Prophet available in Italian!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We are glad to announce that one of our fan, Luca Cassinelli, translated The Blind Prophet in Italian! We have an incredible community and we received a lot of propositions for fan translations - some may still be in progress!


Thanks for your love, thanks for your work, don't hesitate to write us if you spot a problem with this new translation, we'll fix it as fast as possible. 


See you soon, sinners! 

Stay safe.

notes.title: Try out 28 demos right now in the Digital Dragons Indie Celebration
notes.notes:
As expected, another physical event has gone online this year. The Digital Dragons Indie Celebration is the next of the bunch, presenting demos playable through Steam and livestreams with developers to watch. The Covid-19 coronavirus pandemic is cramping our con attendance but the digital format encouraging events to give access to demos that normally would have only been playable in an exhibition hall a plane ride away is a pleasant side effect. Can we, uh, maybe just keep doing this from now on?

(more…)

notes.title: The Blind Prophet is now available in spanish!
notes.notes:
[b]The Blind Prophet is now available in spanish! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33967282/78bf8a6aff48987b2ba17a1ad362d9196ac55a31.jpg[/img]

We promised it during the Kickstarter campaign, and here it is: [b]you can now hunt the malefic forces of Rotbork in spanish language[/b], and we hope you'll love it. It took a little bit of time, but better late than never!

We are still progressing on other translations (fan translation, this time) and we'll keep you in touch. We would like to say [b]thank you once again to our amazing community.[/b]
For any question, join us at arsgoetiagames@gmail.com


Ars Goetia

notes.title: The Blind Prophet gets noticed during worldwide events!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Sinners,[/b]

The past month was busy for us, not only due to the development itself, but also because we took an active part in 2 events around the world. First of all, [b]The Blind Prophet will be finalist in the 7th Indie Game Contest[/b], which will take place at the [b]European Festival of Fantastic Film in Strasbourg[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33967282/0d99a8c51f8f2cb36be68d76d176f0128790a262.jpg[/img]

Another event took place across the ocean, in [b]Brazil![/b] Yes, our game was available on [b]the biggest independent games festival in Latin America, BIG Festival 2019![/b] What's more, The Blind Prophet was noticed by the jury and [b]nominated for the Best Art award[/b], along with 6 other titles from around the world. You can see all the nominees [url=https://www.bigfestival.com.br/nominees-2019.html]here[/url]:

We are incredibly proud of our small achievements as it's another indicator that we're moving our project in the right direction. We hope that you feel this way too :)

[b]Take care,[/b]
[i]The Blind Prophet Devs[/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/968370/The_Blind_Prophet/

notes.title: Progress of the development
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Sinners,[/b]

We've got many questions in the past days about the update on the progress, and why we didn't reveal anything new for a couple of months. The truth is that we are such a small team, that [b]we decided to focus our limited resources on the development[/b] itself, to push the whole project forward as much as we could. Thanks to our amazing community, we realized that it's not enough, so we are back with the official announcement!

We estimate the current state of the development at about [b]75%[/b]. It's still a bit too early for setting the launch date though. We will come back with the proper announcement about it when we are 100% sure about it. We are planning to show you new footage from [b]The Blind Prophet[/b] on our social media channels soon, so please follow our [url=https://www.facebook.com/theblindprophetgame/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/arsgoetiagames?lang=en]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/arsgoetiagames/]Instagram[/url] to stay on top of all things.

A small insight in the meantime? In the last couple of days, we started to prepare the [b]wallpapers[/b] we promised during our [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b]. Here is one of the sketches that will become the base of your exclusive content. We hope you’re as excited about as we are!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33967282/ceebab167a5b17a7cd8d7abd9d8436c9f91eee73.jpg[/img]

All the best,
The Blind Prophet Devs

notes.notes:
[b]Hello Sinners,[/b]

You did it! The main goal of the [url=https://kck.st/2VHkBLK]Kickstarter[/url] campaign for [b]The Blind Prophet [/b]passed [b]100%[/b] of completion! Simple words couldn't describe how grateful we feel right now, so we decided to make a special [i]"thank you"[/i] sketch on this particular occasion. How do you like it?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33967282/50847200ad8706ca24963277b0dcfe5087e40b65.jpg[/img]

There are still [b]6 days[/b] left to reach higher goals. We will highly appreciate it if you can share this news with your friends or give us any form of recommendation. This week started so well, let it finish even better :)

[b]All the best,[/b]
[i]The Blind Prophet Devs[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33967282/40080bc043564741a7efc860a7c5f012309d0cf5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Blind Prophet is announced on Switch, PS4, Xbox One and iOS!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33967282/f9566b376e5888b43164d707ad8e80d0806aa90f.jpg[/img]
[b]Hello Sinners,[/b]

We are coming back to you with a big news today! After a ton of requests from the whole community, we decided to focus, in the last couple of days, on bringing [b]The Blind Prophet[/b] to some new platforms. Now, we are happy to officially announce that we just started developing our game, along with the [b]PC and MAC[/b] versions, on [b]Nintendo Switch, PS4, Xbox One and iOS[/b] platforms!

[b]The Blind Prophet[/b] will be released on [b]PC and MAC this year[/b]. [b]Switch, PS4, Xbox One and iOS versions will launch at a later date[/b], as the game needs some reworking to fit these platforms. The speed of porting depends highly on the scale of the current Kickstarter campaign's success.

We are also one step closer to funding our game. Our fantastic backers managed to reach [b]82%[/b] of the required funding. There are still [b]10 days[/b] of the crowdfunding campaign left, so [b]we invite you warmly to try out our free demo[/b], available through our [b]Kickstarter[/b] page. Follow [url=https://twitter.com/ArsGoetiaGames/status/1083426580012171267]this Tweet[/url] to visit it ːsteamhappyː

[b]Thanks for the support,[/b]
[i]The Blind Prophet Devs[/i]

notes.title: The Blind Prophet is heading to MAC! [*demo v0.4.0 is out!]
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33967282/c2ed408775a6618013ce356e4e3e6c5365eee72f.png[/img]
[b]Hello Sinners,[/b]

We are proud of the initial players' reaction to our Kickstarter campaign! At the moment of writing this message, we already managed to secure [b]2/3[/b] of our goal with [b]19 days[/b] still to go! We are not willing to stop yet though, so we are happy to announce that [b]The Blind Prophet will be released, along with the PC version, on a MAC platform too![/b]

There is also an updated demo version available now [b](v0.4.0)[/b]. English translation got better again with additional bugs being fixed. We encourage you to report us everything that you would like us to change, as we will be more than happy to improve our game further. Check out our latest tweet to get the demo:

https://twitter.com/ArsGoetiaGames/status/1087807633002807296

[b]Have fun,[/b]
[i]The Blind Prophet Devs[/i]

notes.title: 50% milestone, user scores, and updated demo… oh my!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33967282/ea72cf91bdc3f5732b75f16e44de6023f21a33aa.jpg[/img]
[b]Hello Sinners,[/b]

You did it! You just reached another milestone as [b]The Blind Prophet passed the 50% mark on the Kickstarter![/b] There are already [b]200 Point & Click enthusiasts[/b] in here, who decided to back up our project, and we are more than grateful to every single one of you!

Passing that line is very important from the symbolic perspective, so we decided to gather and present you the user scores that our demo got on the platforms where we uploaded it. The image above makes it all clear, but we want to highlight the fact that we managed to receive and maintain the maximum score on both:

[list]
[*] - [b]100% on Gamejolt[/b] (http://bit.ly/2Rp8Jzr)

[*] - [b]5/5 on Itch.io[/b] (http://bit.ly/2Ci6x2e)
[/list]

It helps us so much when you leave us your [b]recommendation[/b], so please do so if you have a minute to spare. We will much appreciate it, as well as following any of our social media channels ([url=https://www.facebook.com/theblindprophetgame/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/ArsGoetiaGames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/theblindprophetgame/]Instagram[/url]). There is no better way to spread the word about The Blind Prophet than sharing our posts with your friends :)

There is more to add though. We keep on working hard to make our demo even better, so we uploaded a new version under the links mentioned earlier [b](v0.3.0)[/b]. Improvements are focussed again on the translation and a couple of small bugs been fixed as well. Have fun playing and keep reporting us about anything you find :)

[b]Take care,[/b]
[i]The Blind Prophet Devs[/i]

notes.title: Improved demo is out now!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Sinners,[/b]

At the start, we want to say how grateful we are to all the backers who helped us to reach [b]40% of our main goal in only 4 days![/b] Reading all your supportive comments and feedback is absolutely fantastic! There are so many positive reactions around the internet that the only thing we want right now is to work even harder! We already gathered a lot of ideas for the development of [b]The Blind Prophet[/b] from our community, and we hope that you can keep your suggestions/reports incoming, as there is always a space for improvements.

To mark reaching another milestone with fanfares, we are happy to announce that the start of the new week brings some of the requested changes in our game! This time, we focussed primarily on the [b]English translation and fixing the reported bugs[/b]. To play the updated version of [b]The Blind Prophet demo[/b], please follow to our [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b] -> https://kck.st/2VHkBLK

Naturally, our work is still not finished, so we can't wait to read your updated feedback :)

[b]Best wishes,[/b]
[i]Ars Goetia Games[/i]

notes.title: Kickstarter launch on the 12 th of January !
notes.notes:
Hey everybody, we are glad to announce that we will launch a Kickstarter campaign on the [u]12th of January 2019[/u] (one week from now). You can secure your early bird price by subscribing here: http://theblindprophetgame.com/
There will be a [b]DEMO[/b] ! :) 

If you like the game, the only way to make it happen is to share and spread the word. You are our best ally in this mission ! 

The Blind Prophet devs
